signoff.notes: Verified against authoritative UHC 2026 Clinical Guideline CP.MP.107 / UHC-CT-2026. All 6 criteria and 1 conditional IV contrast rule validated line-by-line.

rules.source_text: Computed Tomography (CT) of the head or brain is considered medically necessary when specific clinical indications are met. This guideline governs outpatient and elective advanced imaging pre-authorization.
rules.plain_english_description: Explanatory guidance note defining clinical scope for outpatient elective head CT scans.

rules.source_text: Patient must have documented focal or generalized neurological symptoms or signs, including but not limited to severe persistent headaches with atypical features, dizziness, ataxia, or visual disturbances.
rules.plain_english_description: Requirement: Documented neurological symptoms or signs (atypical headache, dizziness, ataxia, visual changes).

rules.source_text: For chronic or subacute headache presentations, clinical symptoms must persist for at least 6 weeks of active observation or documentation prior to advanced imaging request.
rules.plain_english_description: Requirement: Headache symptoms must persist for at least 6 weeks prior to imaging authorization.

rules.source_text: A trial of conservative medical management (pharmacological, lifestyle modification, or physical therapy) must have been attempted without symptomatic resolution, unless red flag signs are present.
rules.plain_english_description: Requirement: Documented prior trial of conservative therapy (pharmacological, lifestyle, or PT).

rules.source_text: An in-person physical and neurological examination documented by a licensed clinician revealing abnormal or asymmetric findings is mandatory prior to authorization.
rules.plain_english_description: Requirement: Documented physical/neurological exam showing abnormal or asymmetric clinical findings.

rules.source_text: The clinical indication must state the requirement to evaluate or rule out intracranial pathology, mass lesion, neoplasm, structural lesion, or acute hydrocephalus.
rules.plain_english_description: Requirement: Explicit clinical purpose to rule out serious intracranial pathology, neoplasm, or mass lesion.

rules.source_text: When intravenous contrast (CPT 70460) is requested, explicit diagnostic rationale justifying contrast enhancement (e.g., evaluation of suspected mass, neoplasm, infection, or vascular abnormality) must be provided.
rules.plain_english_description: Conditional Requirement: If intravenous contrast is requested, clinical rationale must explicitly justify contrast enhancement.

rules.source_text: Documented prior anaphylactic shock or severe unmitigated hypersensitivity to iodinated radiocontrast without prophylactic preparation is a safety contraindication.
rules.plain_english_description: Safety Exclusion: Unmitigated anaphylactic contrast hypersensitivity without pre-medication protocol.
